rationale: The target unfolds to the exact Frobenius-norm submultiplicativity inequality for arbitrary conformable finite real matrices. Its norm is the square root of the sum of real entry squares, its product is the standard exact inner-index sum, and its relation is the paper's non-strict inequality with constant 1.
